reviews.review:
Discovered this thanks to the youtube series called Steam Sequence, I am glad I gave it a go! Been a while since I've done a sidescroller, and the artwork and animation of this was beautiful. The writing and story were very good, and its a nice little game to pick up if you have a free weekend to yourself. They do some really interesting this with the controls and such during certain parts that are quite unique, if a bit to handle that required some rebinding of keys on my end. I used K&M and while it was tricky during those sections I did manage, it does say controller is recommended and I would have to agree.

A couple of notes though, there are quite a few moments lot of flashing lights. I'm not even photosensitive and it was almost too intense for me during those moments. And while its easy to fix, it is also very easy to softlock the final boss so if you all of a sudden find yourself stuck there don't worry.
